name: Aniracetam
lead: Aniracetam is a racetam-family nootropic, a synthetic compound related to piracetam that was developed by Hoffmann-La Roche in the 1970s as Ro 13-5057 [1]. In appearance-focused communities it is discussed as a mood, calm and focus aid: people who take it say it lowers social anxiety and sharpens verbal fluency, which they connect to carrying themselves more confidently and expressively.

Pharmacologically it is best known as a positive allosteric modulator of AMPA-type glutamate receptors, slowing the receptors' desensitization and deactivation [2][3]. In some countries it has been used as a prescription medicine for cognitive decline in older adults, and it is sold elsewhere as a supplement or research chemical [1].

Published human work consists mainly of 1980s and 1990s trials in elderly patients with dementia or cerebrovascular disease, plus a review of animal studies that included models of anxiety, depression and attention [4][5][6].

chain: Users report lower social anxiety and better verbal fluency
angle.text: People use aniracetam hoping for calmer, more fluent social interaction, which they feel shows in expression, eye contact and general presence. The link to looks is through confidence and demeanor rather than any physical change.

card.summary: A racetam nootropic that people take for calm focus and easier social fluency, supporting a more confident, expressive presence.
card.note: Not FDA-approved; available mainly as a supplement or research chemical.

quick.overview:
Aniracetam is a nootropic in the racetam family. It is taken for focus, mood and reduced social anxiety, and in looksmaxxing circles it is mentioned as a way to feel and appear more at ease and articulate in social settings.

It began as a Roche research compound in the 1970s and has been used as a prescription drug for cognitive decline in some countries. Elsewhere it is sold as a supplement.
quick.mechanism: It positively modulates AMPA glutamate receptors, prolonging their response to glutamate, and has been reported in animal work to affect acetylcholine, serotonin and dopamine signalling. It is absorbed and metabolized rapidly, with a short half-life.
quick.risks: Trials in older adults reported it was generally tolerated, with mild gastrointestinal effects the most commonly mentioned. In one 1987 trial confusion led to treatment interruption in a few participants. It is not approved by the FDA or EMA, so products are unregulated in many regions.

infobox: Prescription in some countries (e.g. Italy); not FDA/EMA approved [1]

paras: Aniracetam has no direct physical effect on appearance. Users describe it as taking the edge off social anxiety and improving word-finding and mood, and treat it as a way to come across more relaxed and engaged. These accounts are anecdotal [1].
It has been used in some European countries for behavioral and psychological symptoms of dementia and for cognitive problems after stroke or in Alzheimer's disease [6].

Aniracetam enhances AMPA receptor currents by reducing desensitization and slowing deactivation, an effect described in electrophysiology studies from 1990 onward [2][7][8]. Reviews of racetams also describe interactions with cholinergic systems [9].

After a 200 mg oral dose, its main metabolites, anisic acid and p-methoxyhippuric acid, peaked at about 2 hours in elderly patients with cerebrovascular disease and returned to baseline by about 6 hours [10].

A double-blind trial randomized 44 patients with Alzheimer-type dementia to aniracetam 1 g daily or placebo for three months; confusion interrupted treatment in four aniracetam and one placebo participant [4]. A placebo-controlled multicentre study in senile dementia and a trial in elderly people with mental deterioration were also published [5][11]. An intravenous study used a human hypoxia model [12]. A registered 2026 study is examining IQ-test reliability under modafinil and racetam-class compounds in healthy adults [13]. In pigeons, aniracetam did not improve working memory [14]. No published trial has tested it for social confidence in healthy adults.
From the 2000s aniracetam spread from medical use into nootropics communities, where users reported focus, mood and creativity effects [1].

timeline.event: Synthesized at Hoffmann-La Roche as Ro 13-5057 [1].
Double-blind trial in Alzheimer-type dementia published [4].
Multicentre placebo-controlled study in senile dementia published [5].
